line_input = input()
output_str = ''
size = len(line_input)
at_present = False

for ch in line_input:
    if ch == '@':
        at_present = True

i = 0
while i < size:
    if i + 2 < size and line_input[i] == 'd' and line_input[i+1] == 'o' and line_input[i+2] == 't' and i != 0 and i != size - 3:
        output_str += '.'
        line_input = line_input[:i] + '   ' + line_input[i+3:]
        i += 3
        size -= 3
    elif i + 1 < size and line_input[i] == 'a' and line_input[i+1] == 't' and i != 0 and i != size - 2 and not at_present:
        output_str += '@'
        line_input = line_input[:i] + '  ' + line_input[i+2:]
        at_present = True
        i += 1
        size -= 2
    elif line_input[i] != ' ':
        output_str += line_input[i]
        i += 1
    else:
        i += 1

print(output_str)
